rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sample_mass_nonnegative
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.sample_mass_nonnegative : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) {n : ℕ} (w : Calibration.Sample n),
  0 ≤ Calibration.sampleMass e w

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sample_mass_normalized
rows.printed_type: Calibration.sample_mass_normalized : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ), ∑ w, Calibration.sampleMass e w = 1

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.all_zero_mass
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.all_zero_mass : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ),
  Calibration.sampleMass e (Calibration.zeroSample n) = Calibration.miss e n

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.miss_positive
rows.printed_type: Calibration.miss_positive : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ), 0 < Calibration.miss e n

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.miss_le_one
rows.printed_type: Calibration.miss_le_one : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ), Calibration.miss e n ≤ 1

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.null_error_at_zero
rows.printed_type:
@Calibration.null_error_at_zero : ∀ {n : ℕ} (d : Calibration.Decision n),
  Calibration.nullError d = ↑(d (Calibration.zeroSample n))

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.all_zero_error_contribution
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.all_zero_error_contribution : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) {n : ℕ} (d : Calibration.Decision n),
  Calibration.miss e n * (1 - Calibration.nullError d) ≤ Calibration.alternativeError e d

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sum_error_lower
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.sum_error_lower : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) {n : ℕ} (d : Calibration.Decision n),
  Calibration.miss e n ≤ Calibration.nullError d + Calibration.alternativeError e d

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.worst_error_lower
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.worst_error_lower : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) {n : ℕ} (d : Calibration.Decision n),
  Calibration.miss e n / (1 + Calibration.miss e n) ≤ max (Calibration.nullError d) (Calibration.alternativeError e d)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.threshold_rule_errors
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.threshold_rule_errors : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ) (a : ↑Calibration.Probability),
  Calibration.nullError (Calibration.thresholdRule n a) = ↑a ∧
    Calibration.alternativeError e (Calibration.thresholdRule n a) = Calibration.miss e n * (1 - ↑a)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.balanced_rule_errors
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.balanced_rule_errors : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ),
  Calibration.nullError (Calibration.thresholdRule n (Calibration.balancedProbability e n)) =
      Calibration.miss e n / (1 + Calibration.miss e n) ∧
    Calibration.alternativeError e (Calibration.thresholdRule n (Calibration.balancedProbability e n)) =
      Calibration.miss e n / (1 + Calibration.miss e n)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sharp_sum_error
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.sharp_sum_error : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ),
  IsLeast (Set.range fun d => Calibration.nullError d + Calibration.alternativeError e d) (Calibration.miss e n)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sharp_worst_error
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.sharp_worst_error : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ),
  IsLeast (Set.range fun d => max (Calibration.nullError d) (Calibration.alternativeError e d))
    (Calibration.miss e n / (1 + Calibration.miss e n))

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.sharp_equal_prior_error
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.sharp_equal_prior_error : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ),
  IsLeast (Set.range fun d => (Calibration.nullError d + Calibration.alternativeError e d) / 2)
    (Calibration.miss e n / 2)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.no_finite_certain_decision
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.no_finite_certain_decision : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) {n : ℕ} (d : Calibration.Decision n),
  0 < max (Calibration.nullError d) (Calibration.alternativeError e d)

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.zero_trials_miss
rows.printed_type: Calibration.zero_trials_miss : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate), Calibration.miss e 0 = 1

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.fixed_rate_arbitrarily_accurate
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.fixed_rate_arbitrarily_accurate : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (η : ℝ),
  0 < η → ∃ n d, max (Calibration.nullError d) (Calibration.alternativeError e d) < η

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.miss_lower_rate_bound
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.miss_lower_rate_bound : ∀ (lower e : ↑Calibration.EventRate),
  ↑lower ≤ ↑e → ∀ (n : ℕ), Calibration.miss e n ≤ Calibration.miss lower n

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.bernoulli_lower
rows.printed_type: Calibration.bernoulli_lower : ∀ (e : ↑Calibration.EventRate) (n : ℕ), 1 - ↑n * ↑e ≤ Calibration.miss e n

rows.name: ResearchCommons.Calibration.no_uniform_finite_guarantee
rows.printed_type:
Calibration.no_uniform_finite_guarantee : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ),
  0 ≤ r →
    r < 1 / 2 →
      ∃ e, ∀ (d : Calibration.Decision n), r < max (Calibration.nullError d) (Calibration.alternativeError e d)
